name: track-builder-3d
description: Draw a racetrack with limited ink, then race it in 3D.

scripts.build:web: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode web && node scripts/size.mjs dist/web
scripts.build:cg: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode crazygames && node scripts/size.mjs dist/crazygames
scripts.build:cg:ads: npm run typecheck && ADS=1 vite build --mode crazygames && node scripts/size.mjs dist/crazygames
scripts.package:cg: npm run build:cg && node scripts/zipBuild.mjs dist/crazygames dist/track-builder-3d-crazygames-basic.zip
scripts.package:cg:ads: npm run build:cg:ads && node scripts/zipBuild.mjs dist/crazygames dist/track-builder-3d-crazygames-full.zip
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:cg
